bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (mgmt socket radio, discovery, pairing, connect, forget), springboard/src/media/route.rs (audio sink), springboard/src/shell/pages.rs and settings.rs (Bluetooth settings UI)
summary: The shell drives the radio (power, discovery, Just Works pairing, connect, disconnect, forget) and routes audio to a connected headset through the kernel mgmt socket. No app-facing Bluetooth SDK exists, and none of the RFCOMM, OBEX, SDP, hands-free or user-notification classes have a counterpart.

features.note: Shell only. Apps get no SDK call to read or set the local controller.
Discovery runs through the mgmt socket. No delegate or callback API for apps.

features.feature: Remote device model (name, class, paired, connected)
features.note: A device list exists in the shell's Status. No app API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:68 (NoInputNoOutput Just Works), :73 (PAIR_MS timeout), OP_PAIR_DEVICE, OP_USER_CONFIRM_REPLY
features.note: Just Works (no input, no output) for the pairing the shell started. Legacy PIN requests are answered with a fixed "0000" (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:641-650). No user-entered PIN or passkey.

features.feature: Connect, disconnect and forget a device
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Cmd::Connect, Cmd::Disconnect, Cmd::Forget, OP_DISCONNECT, OP_UNPAIR_DEVICE); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (BluetoothDetail: Connect / Disconnect / Forget This Device)
features.note: Works from the Settings page. Apps cannot connect to a device.

features.feature: Audio output routing to a headset
features.apple: IOBluetoothDevice audio via system audio routing
features.note: Now Playing shows the connected audio device as the route. Selecting it as the output is done by the system audio layer, not by an app API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:894 (link: AF_BLUETOOTH SEQPACKET socket to PSM 1 for BR/EDR or ATT CID 4 for LE)
features.note: The shell opens L2CAP links only to keep a device connected. Apps cannot open a channel to an arbitrary PSM, and there is no channel-close notification.
No RFCOMM code. Needed for serial-style profiles.

features.feature: SDP service records and data elements
features.note: The SDP PSM is used only as the link target in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:894. No SDP queries or records.
No OBEX code. Object exchange over Bluetooth is absent.

features.apple: IOBluetoothHandsFree, IOBluetoothHandsFreeAudioGateway, IOBluetoothHandsFreeDevice and their delegates
features.note: No call control or hands-free profile. The audio route in media/route.rs covers playback only.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/route.rs:273 (test: keyboard is not an audio sink); HID input is left to the kernel
features.note: No API to count or ignore HID devices. Keyboards and mice are not visible to apps through Bluetooth calls.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (EV_DEVICE_CONNECTED :53, EV_DEVICE_DISCONNECTED :54 are handled inside the shell)
features.note: Connect and disconnect events go to the shell's own state. No app subscription API.
Conversion helpers exist inside the shell crate. Not an SDK API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:1-24 (module header: uses the mgmt API instead of raw HCI, by design)
features.note: The shell uses mgmt commands, not the HCI structure set. Apps get none of the HCI or LE types.

gaps: No app-facing Bluetooth SDK module: nothing under springboard/sdk/src/ covers Bluetooth.
No RFCOMM, OBEX or SDP support (no code anywhere in springboard/).
No app API to open L2CAP channels to arbitrary PSMs or receive device events.
Pairing has no user-entered PIN or passkey flow; only Just Works and a fixed "0000" legacy PIN are handled.
No HID device counts or ignore controls exposed to apps.
